schoolDivisionId.name: Food Technology
schoolDivisionId.about: In a world facing unprecedented population growth and climate volatility, the scope of Food Technology extends far beyond simple processing. It is the critical bridge between agricultural production and human health. Our department recognizes Food Technologists as the architects of global health—professionals who engineer functional foods, ensure the highest standards of safety, and optimize the nutritional value of what the world eats. The food industry remains one of the largest and most resilient economic sectors globally. Our department is committed to meeting this immense industry capacity by producing skilled professionals who are ready to lead in multinational corporations, reputed research & development facilities, and entrepreneurial ventures. Throughout their studies, students are exposed to a wide range of opportunities including international workshops, industry-led internships, and intensive in-plant training in modern pilot plants. Our curriculum is meticulously designed to merge the fundamental principles of Biological Sciences with Advanced Engineering, preparing students to address the complex challenges of the 21st-century food supply chain.

name: B. Tech. – Biotechnology with Specialization in Food Technology Bridging Science, Engineering, and Sustainability
overview:
Biotechnology with a Specialization in Food Technology is an interdisciplinary undergraduate program that merges biological sciences and engineering principles to improve the safety, quality, nutritional value, and sustainability of food systems. This specialized curriculum equips students with a deep knowledge of molecular biology, bioprocessing, protein engineering, food chemistry, and plant & animal biotechnology, alongside advanced engineering practices such as food processing, biotransformation, preservation, and packaging.

With food security, functional foods, and alternative protein sources becoming critical focus areas for global sustainability, this engineering branch acts as the next evolutionary step in food production systems. Modern technological advancements allow students to learn how to minimize food waste, optimize supply chains, and manufacture functional food products using automated and biotechnological solutions. From engineering fortified nutrition to managing global agricultural supply pipelines, biotechnology paired with food technology plays an indispensable role in public health, commercial food manufacturing, quality control, and regulatory affairs.

name: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering
overview: Computer Science and Engineering is a dynamic field that focuses on both the theoretical foundations and practical applications of computing, integrating principles of mathematics, engineering, software, and hardware. It has significantly transformed society over the past few decades and continues to drive innovation across industries such as banking, e-commerce, healthcare, finance, security, and logistics. With the rapid advancement of technology, the demand for skilled computer science professionals is steadily increasing, offering diverse career opportunities including roles such as System Engineer, Data Scientist, Software Developer, Analyst, and Researcher. Pursuing a degree in Computer Science and Engineering equips students with essential technical and problem-solving skills, making them highly sought after in the IT industry, while also providing strong pathways for higher education such as M.Tech, M.E., MBA, and other specialized programs.

name: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Cyber Security
overview: In today’s digital age, where technology is transforming every aspect of our lives, the need for skilled professionals who can protect our online systems and networks from cyber threats has become paramount. Our program is designed to equip students with the knowledge and skills required to tackle the ever-evolving challenges of Cybersecurity. The B.Tech. program in Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Cybersecurity is a four-year undergraduate program aimed at providing students with a strong foundation in computer science principles while focusing on the specialized field of Cybersecurity. The curriculum has been carefully crafted to blend theoretical knowledge with practical skills, ensuring that students gain a deep understanding of the underlying concepts and are capable of applying them in real-world scenarios.

schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Cyber security
schoolDivisionId.about:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Cyber security at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli Campus, is committed to providing quality technical education, fostering research and innovation, and developing industry-ready professionals capable of addressing the rapidly evolving challenges of the digital world. The department strives to create a dynamic academic environment that integrates theoretical foundations, practical expertise, emerging technologies, and professional ethics.
The department offers a comprehensive undergraduate learning experience combining the fundamental principles of Computer Science and Engineering with specialized knowledge in Cyber security, Network Security, Ethical Hacking, Cryptography, Digital Forensics, Cloud Computing, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Internet of Things (IoT) Security. Through outcome-based education, innovative teaching methodologies, and experiential learning practices, students are encouraged to develop analytical thinking, technical proficiency, creativity, and problem-solving capabilities.
The department is supported by  highly qualified faculty members, all holding Ph.D. degrees, with expertise in Cyber security, Networking, Cloud Computing, Distributed Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and interdisciplinary computing applications. Faculty members actively contribute to scholarly publications, patent initiatives, research supervision, technical training, and professional development activities. The department's research-oriented academic environment promotes collaborative learning, knowledge creation, and technological advancement.
A distinguishing strength of the department is its emphasis on industry-integrated education and practical skill development. Industry engagement with organizations such as Fortinet and Cisco provides opportunities to strengthen practical knowledge and professional competencies. The department's Fortinet industry laboratory resources, including FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, and FortiSIEM, support learning in network security, threat monitoring, security analysis, and security operations. Industry-supported activities help bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world technological requirements.
The department actively promotes student engagement through its technical clubs, along with professional platforms such as ACM and IEEE student chapters. These initiatives encourage participation in Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, ethical hacking challenges, cybersecurity awareness programmes, technical workshops, peer learning, and collaborative problem-solving activities.
With a strong commitment to academic excellence, industry exposure, innovation, and professional ethics, the department aims to nurture technically competent, socially responsible, and globally competitive engineers capable of contributing to the development of a secure and resilient digital ecosystem

name: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
overview: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the simulations of human intelligence in robots that have been trained to think and act like humans. The phrase can also refer to any machine that demonstrates human-like characteristics like learning and problem-solving. Artificial intelligence’s finest feature is its ability to reason and take actions that have the best possibility of reaching a certain goal. Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that relates to the concept of computer programs learning from and adapting to new data without the assistance of humans. Deep learning algorithms allow for this autonomous learning by absorbing large volumes of unstructured data, including text, photos, and video. After two decades of Google, social media, and widespread smartphone use, Artificial Intelligence (AI) will be the next Big Thing in technology transformation. Artificial intelligence has found a particular place in people’s homes and daily lives as Smart Home Assistants and smart cities. Artificial intelligence and machine learning are becoming increasingly important in fields such as health care, agriculture, manufacturing, and defense. Amazon Echo and Google Home are popular smart home devices that allow you to perform a range of tasks simply by speaking to them.

schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
schoolDivisionId.about:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering with specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning educates more than 1,000 undergraduate and postgraduate students to design, build and deploy intelligent systems. It pairs strong computing foundations with industry-mentored projects, active research and close personal mentoring.
The department is part of the School of Computing at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli, a campus of the NAAC A++ accredited SRMIST. Its students come from Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and other states; nearly half are from outside Tamil Nadu, and about one in three is a woman. Over 90% of the faculty hold a Ph.D., and their work spans computer vision, medical imaging, natural language processing, edge AI and intelligent IoT systems.

The development of intelligent machines as AI products, intelligent software as computer software, or applications using a combination of machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques will be covered in the next two years of courses.

name: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Data Sciences
overview: Data science has evolved as one of the most pioneering and in-demand career avenues. This interdisciplinary field amalgamates the deployment of scientific methodologies to transform the knowledge extracted from the data into tangible business insights. The field of Data science covers a very broad spectrum of technologies to facilitate the understanding of technical results from enormous data. The department offers a B.Tech CSE with a specialization in Data Science to facilitate the student’s development into skilled professionals capable of mining business values from data by leveraging statistical and analytical techniques.

schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Big Data Analytics and Data Science
schoolDivisionId.about:
In a world where every digital interaction generates data and every connected system contributes to an ever-expanding information landscape, the ability to analyse, interpret, and harness data has become a driving force for innovation and informed decision-making. The Department of Big Data Analytics and Data Science brings together the foundations of Computer Science, the analytical power of Data Science, and the capabilities of Big Data technologies to prepare students to transform vast and complex datasets into meaningful insights, intelligent solutions, and real-world impact.

The department focuses on developing students’ abilities to understand data, identify patterns, uncover hidden opportunities, and address complex challenges through data-driven thinking. The learning environment integrates data science, statistical analysis, machine learning, data management, Big Data technologies, data visualisation, cloud-based analytics, and intelligent systems. Students gain exposure to the complete data lifecycle, from collecting and processing information to analysing large-scale datasets, communicating insights effectively, and applying analytical outcomes to practical challenges.

The curriculum encourages exploration across diverse domains, including business, healthcare, finance, the Internet of Things (IoT), intelligent systems, and emerging technology applications. Students are also encouraged to understand how data moves through interconnected systems, how large-scale information can support strategic decisions, and how analytical technologies can create value for organisations and society. Through hands-on learning, projects, internships, research, and industry-oriented initiatives, they develop the technical expertise, analytical mindset, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities required to address evolving technological challenges.

With dedicated faculty, a dynamic learning environment, and a strong emphasis on innovation, research, and continuous learning, the department strives to nurture a new generation of data scientists, Big Data professionals, technology innovators, and responsible problem solvers who can transform data into knowledge, knowledge into actionable intelligence, and intelligence into meaningful impact across an increasingly data-driven world.

name: M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
overview: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the simulations of human intelligence in robots that have been trained to think and act like humans. The phrase can also refer to any machine that demonstrates human-like characteristics like learning and problem-solving. Artificial intelligence’s finest feature is its ability to reason and take actions that have the best possibility of reaching a certain goal. Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that relates to the concept of computer programs learning from and adapting to new data without the assistance of humans. Deep learning algorithms allow for this autonomous learning by absorbing large volumes of unstructured data, including text, photos, and video. After two decades of Google, social media, and widespread smartphone use, Artificial Intelligence (AI) will be the next Big Thing in technology transformation. Artificial intelligence has found a particular place in people’s homes and daily lives as Smart Home Assistants and smart cities. Artificial intelligence and machine learning are becoming increasingly important in fields such as health care, agriculture, manufacturing, and defense. Amazon Echo and Google Home are popular smart home devices that allow you to perform a range of tasks simply by speaking to them.

schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
schoolDivisionId.about:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering with specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning educates more than 1,000 undergraduate and postgraduate students to design, build and deploy intelligent systems. It pairs strong computing foundations with industry-mentored projects, active research and close personal mentoring.
The department is part of the School of Computing at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli, a campus of the NAAC A++ accredited SRMIST. Its students come from Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and other states; nearly half are from outside Tamil Nadu, and about one in three is a woman. Over 90% of the faculty hold a Ph.D., and their work spans computer vision, medical imaging, natural language processing, edge AI and intelligent IoT systems.
